description: `senior-data-engineer/scripts/data_quality_validator.py` has a broken CLI wiring: `DataQualityValidator.__init__` expects a single `config: Dict`, but `main()` instantiates it with `(args.target, verbose=...)`, and then calls `tool.run()` even though the class only defines `process()` (no `run()` method). This will raise `TypeError`/`AttributeError` and makes the script unusable as documented.

locations.section: class DataQualityValidator.__init__ signature vs main(): tool instantiation and tool.run() call

description: `senior-data-engineer/scripts/pipeline_orchestrator.py` has the same concrete CLI defects as the other tools: the class constructor signature is `__init__(self, config: Dict)` but `main()` passes `(args.target, verbose=...)`, and `main()` calls `tool.run()` which is not implemented (only `process()` exists). Script will fail at runtime.

description: `senior-data-engineer/scripts/etl_performance_optimizer.py` has invalid CLI wiring: `EtlPerformanceOptimizer.__init__` expects `config: Dict`, but `main()` instantiates it with `(args.target, verbose=...)` and calls a nonexistent `tool.run()` method (only `process()` exists). This is a direct runtime error.

description: `senior-data-engineer/scripts/stream_processor.py` generates invalid Flink scaffolding: the generated PyFlink code string uses `DeliveryGuarantee.EXACTLY_ONCE` but does not import `DeliveryGuarantee`, so the generated job will not run. The generated Java code string also references `DeliveryGuarantee.EXACTLY_ONCE` without importing `DeliveryGuarantee`, so it will not compile.

`senior-data-engineer/HOW_TO_USE.md` instructs users to run the provided Python tools directly (e.g., `data_quality_validator.py`, `etl_performance_optimizer.py`, `pipeline_orchestrator.py`), but these scripts currently crash due to the constructor/method mismatches in their `main()` functions, making the usage instructions inaccurate.
